t.Operar con apalancamiento desde Kosmara: Trade with leverage from Kosmara through perpetuals protocols, without custody of your funds.
t.Cada depósito va entero al protocolo de: Each deposit goes in full to the destination protocol and is withdrawn from there. It never passes through the Kosmara treasury.
t.Rango con la liquidez del pool, asas par: Range with the pool's liquidity, handles to adjust it and a candle chart. The NFT goes straight to your wallet.

t.BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, AVAX y más, nativos: BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, AVAX and more, native and without bridges. You sign from your Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base or Avalanche wallet.
t.Los puntos aún no están activos y no tie: Points are not active yet and have no monetary value. If Kosmara launches MARA, they will be the basis for the initial distribution.
t.El precio puede salir de tu rango y pued: The price can leave your range and you may end up with less value than if you had just held the tokens (impermanent loss).
t.Quien ejecuta la operación es ese protoc: The transaction is executed by that protocol. If you open a position on Orca, Orca creates the NFT and deposits it in your wallet.
t.Depositas, tu dinero trabaja en protocol: You deposit, your money works in yield protocols and you withdraw whenever you want. Most of the interest is yours; the rest buys back and burns the Kosmara token.
t.Kosmara no es un banco ni un exchange: e: Kosmara is not a bank or an exchange: it's an interface. It prepares each transaction with the destination protocol's official tools and hands it to you to sign in your wallet.
t.Simulación. El rendimiento de partida es: Simulation. The starting yield is USDC's on Jupiter Earn right now; real yield changes daily and is not guaranteed. The vault doesn't exist yet and doesn't accept deposits.
t.Solana con Jupiter; Ethereum, BNB Chain,: Solana with Jupiter; Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche, HyperEVM, Robinhood Chain, Polygon, Optimism, Unichain, Monad, Sonic and Linea with LI.FI and KyberSwap, picking the best price.
t.El autoswap deja tus fondos en la propor: The autoswap leaves your funds in the range's ratio. The position (NFT) is created by the protocol when you deposit; Kosmara's own contract will come later. DFlow note: it's included in the Jupiter option.
t.Kosmara premiará el uso real del protoco: Kosmara will reward real use of the protocol with points: swapping tokens, opening positions, keeping them in range. The plan is for those points to be the basis for distributing MARA, the protocol token, when it launches.
t.MARA está pensado para dar ventajas dent: MARA is designed to give perks inside Kosmara, such as fee discounts and access to advanced features. It doesn't exist yet: there's no date, supply or price, and nobody should buy anything under that name.
t.DeFi está repartido en decenas de webs,: DeFi is spread across dozens of sites, each with its own interface, network and wallet. Comparing yields, moving liquidity and keeping track of what you've done means opening many tabs and relying on memory.
t.Prototipo sin auditar. Los swaps de este: Unaudited prototype. Swaps in this prototype are real and move funds from your wallet: try small amounts. The position (NFT) is created on the chosen protocol; Kosmara's own contract will come later.
t.Los ingresos previstos vienen de una peq: Planned revenue comes from a small fee on swaps and, later, optional services such as alerts or reports. Today Kosmara charges no fee of its own: you only pay the protocol's and the network's fees.
t.No custodia fondos, claves ni NFT: cada: It holds no funds, keys or NFTs: you prepare each transaction here, sign it in your wallet, and the destination protocol executes it (Orca, Jupiter, LI.FI, KyberSwap, THORChain…).
t.Úsalo con importes pequeños y revisa sie: Use small amounts and always check what you sign.
t.Un envío a una dirección equivocada no s: A transfer to the wrong address cannot be undone.
t.Los pools pueden sufrir pérdida imperman: Pools can suffer impermanent loss; prices move and yield is not guaranteed. Each protocol has its own contracts and risks.
t.Nada de lo que ves aquí es asesoramiento: Nothing here is financial or tax advice. You are responsible for complying with the laws of your country.
t.Kosmara no te pide email, nombre ni regi: Kosmara doesn't ask for your email, name or sign-up.
t.Para mostrar saldos y movimientos se con: To show balances and activity, your public addresses are looked up on the blockchain and on services like Jupiter, LI.FI or GeckoTerminal.
t.Tus preferencias (idioma, wallet usada,: Your preferences (language, wallet used, own RPC) are stored only in this browser and you can clear them anytime.
